title: features/link/play.feature and the runner crates/apricity-cli/tests/link_play.rs (red first)
description:
## Intent
Write the M2 stories as `features/link/play.feature` and a cucumber runner, and watch them fail.

Stories: apricitus-5a32fd, apricitus-94776e, apricitus-a4072b, apricitus-627e11, apricitus-392ae1.

## Steps
1. `features/link/play.feature`: the Gherkin verbatim; extend `features/link/STEPS.md` with the session steps (peers, tempo, start/stop, "within the tolerance" = native tolerance from `design/link.md`).
2. `crates/apricity-cli/tests/link_play.rs` (cucumber-rs, `harness = false`): runs the play loop with a `ScriptedSession` and the silent clock, capturing stderr and output. If `play.rs` is only reachable from the binary, move its core behind a small `src/lib.rs` in `apricity-cli` so the runner can inject the session (no hidden test flags).
3. Usage-error scenarios run the real binary (`env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_apricity")`) as `tests/sync_cli.rs` does.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-cli --test link_play` shows the scenarios failing on their Then steps.

Commit: with the implementing tasks, or `test(<this task id>)`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
